The stormtroopers don't like people like me''"
"''Oh, I think I understand, Synara. My Great Grand-Nikto told me about the Empire. There were stories of the stormtroopers not being very nice to our people.|Synara San and Neeku Vozo|audio=NeekusGreatGrandNikto-TheFirstOrderOccupation.flac|}} A [[Nikto]] was the '''Great Grand-Nikto''' of the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Neeku Vozo]]. They lived during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and witnessed its [[stormtrooper]]s being [[Xenophobia|not very nice]] to Niktos. At some point after the Empire's [[Battle of Jakku|fall]] in [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' they told Vozo about the Empire and stories of the stormtroopers treatment of Niktos. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|1|15}} during the [[First Order]]'s [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupation]] of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'', the mechanic told the [[pirate]] [[Synara San]] and the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] about what his [[Neeku Vozo's tribe|Great-Grand Nikto]] had told him after San informed Vozo she wanted to leave the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]] as the Order's [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] would not like a person like her. ==Behind the scenes== Neeku Vozo's Great Grand-Nikto was mentioned in "[[The First Order Occupation]]," the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} which aired on [[February 3]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The First Order Occupation}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Vozo, Neeku's Great Grand-Nikto}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Nikto]]
